functions.purpose: Iterates a named callback table ('Callbacks') read from the weapon/skill state definition (CInfoRecord::GetModelString) and dispatches each entry by name to a concrete handler. Outer key must be 'Callbacks'; then for each child it reads the child's name and, when it has a value, string-matches SetValue/SetGValue/HolsterItem/SetAGInput and a long chain of FUN_10a675d0(...) probes to ~30 weapon-effect handlers (FUN_10fc3b60..FUN_10fd0280 range). Also handles per-callback sub-keys OnEnter/Update/OnLeave/SetCanDodge/SetCannotDodge/CheckFps by pushing thunk closures (FUN_10f7ef40/FUN_10f7eff0/FUN_10f7f040/FUN_10f7f100) into the state's callback vectors at param_2+0xbc/0xc0. Ref-counted string plumbing (FUN_10c3d780/FUN_10c3dab0/DAT_123be268) throughout.
formulas: Outer table name must equal 'Callbacks' (strcmp) else whole function no-ops
HolsterItem branch caches local_30 = *(param_2+0x50) before FUN_10f57110
SetCanDodge (in OnEnter/Update): pushes closure FUN_10f7ef40 into vector param_2+0xbc (grow-by-8 when +0xbc==+0xc0)
string heap-alloc: DAT_123be268 += _Size + 0xd on alloc, -= (*(p-4)+0xd) on free (CryString COW refcount at p-0xc, p-4=capacity)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only - drives client-side weapon animation/FX callback registration from state-machine data (SetValue/PlayWeaponFX/ShowReloading/ToggleAimMode/SetDefence etc.). No authoritative game state; server does not need this dispatch. The callback NAMES are a useful inventory of weapon FSM hooks.
functions.notes: Handler names visible in strings: SetValue, SetGValue, HolsterItem, SetAGInput, ShowReloading, SetFpsMode, WE05SetFpsMode, TerrainFX, SetRotation, PlayWeaponFX, CallCrosshairsUI, SetDefence, RotateByInput, ToggleAimMode, PlayWeaponAnim, ShowWeaponItem, SendLogicEvent, NeedResetDirByPreState. The 30-deep FUN_10a675d0 chain maps each remaining name to one handler; exact name->handler pairing not resolvable without the string table for FUN_10a675d0 args.

functions.purpose: Maps a player action/input command name (string) to an integer action-ID enum written to *param_2, returning 1 on match / 0 on no-match. First lowercases the input in place (chars 'A'..'Z' += 0x20). Then compares against a fixed table. For 'direction' variants it also writes a 2D direction vector into param_3[0]/param_3[1] as floats.

DAT_11dce978->8, crouch->9, DAT_11dce988->0xa(10), creep->0xb, rage1->0xc, rage2->0xd, rage3->0xe, rage_transmission->0xf

direction->0x24 (no vector); direction_right->0x24 with param_3[0]=0x3f800000(1.0f),param_3[1]=0; direction_left->0x24 param_3[0]=0xbf800000(-1.0f),param_3[1]=0; direction_back->0x24 param_3[0]=0,param_3[1]=0xbf800000(-1.0f); direction_front->0x24 param_3[0]=0,param_3[1]=0x3f800000(1.0f)

functions.notes: DAT_11ccdbec/dbf4, DAT_11cface8, DAT_11dce978/988 are string literals not shown (likely basic-attack / creep-crouch variants). Enum IDs derived by matching each nested else-branch to its if by nesting depth.

functions.purpose: Core weapon/skill state-transition request. Aborts if busy flag (char)param_1[0x42]!=0. Resolves the active weapon component via FUN_10fde0a0 (returns extension vector; [8]=component). Handles a 'sm_ignoreSkill'-gated fast path and an aim-direction path for gun/bow (COMBAT_PL05_AIM/COMMONSHOOT/CHARGE/HEAVYSHOOT/HEAVYSHOOTS). Computes a normalized aim direction and a rotation quaternion/basis from the target's velocity vector, iterates the state's transition-condition list (piStack_100[0x89..0x8a]) evaluating each predicate (piVar20[1] callback) and, on match, applies via FUN_10fd7800. Builds a network state-change packet (vfunc +0xf8 encode, FUN_10bf81b0 serialize, vfunc +0x228 send/apply) then runs cleanup lists (memmove-based vector compaction of active states at [0x30]).
formulas: component = FUN_10fde0a0()[8]; abort if list==self or component==0

aim math constants: 0.70710677 (=sqrt(0.5), fStack_90 default), DAT_11de9950 (*2 midpoint scale for piStack_9c = (b0+b0)*DAT_11de9950), DAT_11de9978 (bias added after normalize), DAT_11de98e0 (min-length epsilon), DAT_11de9c80 (sign-flip xor mask), DAT_11cc06d8 (fallback angle)
len2 = b8*b8 + d0*d0 (horizontal speed^2); sqrt via libm_sse2_sqrt_precise; if len>DAT_11de98e0 normalize else use fallback
attack-flag: piStack_f0 = (char)param_7!=0 ? ... ; set to 2 if uStack_138 high byte set (charged)
transition list walked at component[0x89]..[0x8a] in stride 3 ints; predicate = piVar20[1], action-check FUN_10fd7800; on-hit cleanup FUN_10c3d5d0 when piVar20[2]!=0
DAT_120286b8+0x538 (combat-mode gate), +0x54c==1 (special transition branch FUN_10fd7bc0/80f0/81a0), +0x209 (dev/debug gate)
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative/validation - this is the client's skill/state-change request builder; it computes the requested state + aim direction locally and transmits to the server (vfunc +0xf8 build, +0x228 apply/send). Server must independently validate the transition is legal (predicate list), the aim direction, and the charged/attack flags. The transition-list layout (component[0x89..0x8a], stride 3, [1]=predicate, [2]=cleanup) and the sm_ignoreSkill cvar gate are load-bearing.
functions.notes: Very large (4671 bytes) with heavy register-spill noise (unaff_ESI/EDI, decompiler-invented locals). Exact packet field layout uncertain. DAT_1202e818 is the global game framework/system hub (env). iStack_88/piStack_100/piStack_fc are the player+weapon components.

functions.purpose: Iterates the current state's transition table and, for each candidate whose target state != 'INVALID_STATE', checks whether the associated skill is castable before allowing the transition. Resolves the transition's skill via FUN_10fb8080, looks up the skill def (FUN_116cd730/FUN_116cd660), and gates on: skill enabled, cooldown/availability (FUN_117194d0 + FUN_11719420 count > 0), and a per-skill castable check FUN_1139aa90(skillId, ammo/resource). If ('sm_ignoreSkill' cvar set) OR skill invalid (id==-1) OR resource-available, executes the transition (func_0x10f6bb80 / FUN_10f59ff0). If the availability call returns state==2 (blocked) and skill valid, sets a block flag *(player+0x18)+0x40 = 1 and returns 0.
formulas: inner transition entries stride 0x48 (iVar10 += 0x48; end at *(iVar1+4))
skillId resolve: iVar10 = *(iVar7+0x14); if ==-1 and iVar8!=0 then iVar10 = *(iVar8+0x1c4)

local_5 (castable) default 1; if skillId>0: def=FUN_116cd660; if def==0 -> local_5=0; else if *(def+0x2d)!=0 && FUN_117194d0(skillId)==1 && FUN_11719420(skillId)>0 -> local_5 = FUN_1139aa90(skillId, ammoIndex)
availability = vfunc(+0x18)(skillId,&local_18); allow if avail==0 && local_5==1; execute if local_6||local_7||allow
functions.serverRelevance: validation/authoritative - this is client-side skill-cooldown/resource gating for combo transitions. Server must enforce the same: skill enabled flag (def+0x2d), cooldown ready (FUN_117194d0/FUN_11719420 count), resource/ammo castable (FUN_1139aa90), and the block state==2. DAT_120286b8+0x9d4 selects which transition bucket. Transition array stride 0xc (buckets) / 0x48 (entries); skillId at entry+0x14 with fallback to +0x1c4.
functions.notes: FUN_1139aa90/117194d0/11719420/116cd660 are the skill-instance manager (cooldowns, charges) - out of chunk. sm_ignoreSkill is a dev/debug cvar (DAT_1203d0f0).

functions.serverRelevance: authoritative - additional buffs the area applies beyond the primary buffID. Server must apply the full extend-buff set. FUN_10d60090 appends to the list.
